title: Highlight headroom
description: A blue-striped enamel loop compares controlled highlight compression with hard clipping under the same exposure.
useCase: Art-direct bright material reflections while seeing what hard clipping removes.
interaction: Drag horizontally or move Exposure from −2 to +2 EV; compare the roll-off region with the clipping sliver.
reducedMotion: The scene has no autonomous motion. Exposure changes update immediately through pointer, touch or keyboard input.
limitations: An SDR presentation of a procedural linear-radiance signal, not an HDR display test. The tone curve is an authored monotonic shoulder, not a certified reference operator. WebGL 1 with original SVG fallback and context restoration.
look: White enamel ring with a cobalt stripe on near-black; a narrow right-hand clipping comparison and an exposure slider.
motion: Exposure multiplies the same linear radiance on both sides before display encoding. `toneMap` compresses the left side through `shoulder`; the right side clamps channels to display white.
adapt: `DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the `config` prop expose shoulder start, strength, light width and hue preservation. `shoulder` and `toneMap` operate on linear radiance; `u_exposure` is independent EV stage state and `encode` applies display gamma afterward.
